newsitem.title: USA: PG&E Diablo Canyon unit back up to 97 pct.
newsitem.headline: PG&E Diablo Canyon unit back up to 97 pct.

text.p: The 1,073 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at Pacific Gas and Electric Co's Diablo Canyon nuclear plant was back up to 97 percent capacity Monday morning after being powered down over the weekend, a company spokesman said.
The unit, located in central California, was expected to reach 100 percent by mid-day Monday.
Power output from unit 2 was reduced due to the outage of a 1,100 MW pumped storage hydroelectric project, which typically consumes much of Diablo Canyon's off-peak output, spokesman Jeff Lewis said.

Separately, Diablo Canyon's 1,087 MW unit 2 was back to full power late Sunday after being taken as low as 30 percent on Saturday for scheduled replacement of a reactor coolant flow transmitter, he added.
